messages.subject: R810 source package complete; qualification UNRUN
messages.body: Created the 202512-byte source-only package at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/own-vllm-xe2-native16-v1 with the actual pinned vLLM BSD xe_gemm adaptation, supplied-queue adapter, standalone numerics/BF16-chain fixture and optional default-OFF CMake recipe. The manifest SHA-256 is 1cbd9083df5ce2db52c193232e01ec160fbed9415cc4ba9f53cb3cc3d1726ebf and SHA256SUMS SHA-256 is d94820167bb928ab44f90e0dd6f372265bdb697f34613e81c1ec022682768019, with exact vLLM/TLA pins and 207 per-header license/hash entries while the unresolved policy implementation remains excluded. Compile, link, GPU, numerics, instruction proof, performance, model quality and physical 262144-context checks are UNRUN; remaining compile gates are LLVM/TLA builtin, vISA and property compatibility plus row-major W and strided mixed-output selector instantiations for Main to qualify.
